email-1.subject: Three winners. A $5,000 garden. Join us Saturday.
email-1.html:
Three prizes, one live announcement. Keep your phone nearby on October 3.

THE BIG GARDEN GIVEAWAY

Three winners.
Three ways to grow.

Saturday, October 3 · 10 AM Phoenix time
Live on Instagram @soilseedandwater

Your next garden could start this Saturday. Join us as we announce three giveaway winners and introduce our garden beds and soil options.

We’re announcing three giveaway winners:

GRAND PRIZE
Your $5,000 complete garden

Two 4×8 raised beds with planting soil, compost, worm castings, mulch, gravel, ground cloth, and wood chips—plus garden instruction to help you get started.

Second prize — Your raised-bed starter garden
One 4×8 bed with starter soil, compost, castings, and mulch, plus setup instructions and a Phoenix planting guide.
Third prize — A full pallet of premium planting soil
Give your raised beds, containers, or next garden project a fresh start.
To claim your prize, answer our call.

You don’t need to watch the livestream to win, but you do need to answer our call.

We’ll call selected winners between approximately 10:15 and 11 AM Phoenix time on October 3. Please keep your phone nearby and your ringer on.

If you don’t answer when we call, we’ll move on and select another winner for that prize.

Follow us on Instagram so you’re ready to join. We’ll also introduce our garden beds and soil options.

Follow us on Instagram

Add to my Google Calendar →

Thanks for growing with us,
Soil Seed & Water
